BiblicalUsage: The word is a deep sleep, a trance God sends. God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam and took a rib; a deep sleep fell upon Abram as the horror of great darkness came over him; a deep sleep from the Lord fell on Saul's camp so David could take the spear and the cruse of water. Isaiah says the Lord hath poured out the spirit of deep sleep, and Job says God speaks in dreams, in deep sleep upon the bed.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the deep sleep is God's doing, whether He is making a wife, making a covenant, or guarding His anointed. My position is that when God puts a man to sleep, He is working, not wasting time, and the sleeper wakes to a new thing.
